questions.target: amount to 表示实际造成的效果
questions.skill: 区分实际后果、正式规定与原因
questions.passage: A journal invited researchers to make their data public alongside their papers. Yet it charged a fee for each file, which made the service expensive for teams with large collections of data. For groups whose grants had ended, the fee amounted to a ban on sharing their full records. They could afford to post a few examples, and some did, but readers could not examine the complete material. Formally, every author had the same opportunity. In practice, the fee limited who could make use of it.
questions.q: What does "amounted to a ban" imply about the fee?
o: It was introduced after the journal formally banned files.
It allowed full access only to readers who had already paid.
It effectively kept some teams from sharing all their data.
It was charged mainly on the files from successful studies.
questions.answer_support: For groups whose grants had ended, the fee amounted to a ban on sharing their full records.

exp.trans: 期刊邀请研究人员随文章公开数据，却逐文件收费。经费已用完的团队只发得起少量样例。制度上所有作者都可以发，费用在实际中使部分团队无法分享完整记录。
exp.structure: 首句交代准入规则，中间解释费用如何限制不同团队。最后两句对照书面机会与实际结果。
exp.other: alongside（与……一起）、grant（科研经费）、make use of（利用）。
exp.meaning: amounted to a ban 指收费对部分团队产生了与禁令相似的效果。这些团队仍在书面规则允许公开数据的范围内。
exp.rest: 题中收费对象是上传者，限制发生在分享之前。读者付费、按研究成败收费和正式禁令都没有文本依据。

questions.skill: 区分报告数量变化与真实问题变化
questions.q: A clinic switched to an online incident form, after which recorded reports rose. External audits found no increase in underlying faults. Which conclusion is best supported?
o: The underlying fault rate rose because the clinic changed its form.
More recorded incidents may reflect easier reporting, not more faults.
External audits proved the old reporting system had been accurate.
The clinic changed the form after a separate review found fewer faults.

exp.trans: 诊所改用在线事件表单后，记录的报告增加了，但外部审计没有发现实际故障增加。记录数量的上升可能来自报告更容易，而不是故障变多。
exp.structure: A clinic switched...描述制度变化；after which引出其后的记录变化；External audits found...提供独立证据，限制对真实故障率的推断。
exp.other: incident form 事件报告表；recorded report 记录的报告；external audit 外部审计；underlying fault 实际故障。
exp.meaning: 观测到的报告数会受到报告渠道影响。记录数增加不能单独证明实际问题变多。
exp.rest: 表单变化本身不能证明故障率上升；审计没有证明旧系统完全准确；文中没有说改表单之前另一次审查发现故障减少。

questions.target: 观察、原因与针对性行动
questions.skill: 根据相邻句的因果关系还原场景
questions.passage: A furniture maker noticed that returns were rising even though customers were ordering the right parts. The error occurred in the storeroom, where boxes containing different fittings looked nearly identical. The boxes, which were stacked sideways to save space, had product numbers on the front and plain sides facing out. When two workers were asked to fill the same sample order, they picked different parts. The supervisor put the numbers on the sides of the boxes. Returns due to packing errors soon declined.
questions.q: Why did the supervisor add numbers to the sides of the boxes?
o: To identify parcels that customers had returned without the receipts.
To let staff identify parts while the boxes were still on the shelf.
To help customers look up alternative parts when supplies ran low.
To indicate which boxes had already been checked before dispatch.
questions.answer_support: The boxes, which were stacked sideways to save space, had product numbers on the front and plain sides facing out.

exp.trans: 家具厂发现客户下对了单，退货却增加了。包装相近的配件箱横着堆放时，工作人员看不到印在正面的编号。两名员工按同一订单拿了不同配件后，主管把编号印到侧面，因配件装错造成的退货随即减少。
exp.structure: 先看异常，即同一订单拿出的配件不同。再找原因，即箱子横放使正面编号不可见。最后核对行动，把编号印在露出来的侧面。which were stacked sideways to save space 补充箱子的摆放方式。
exp.other: fittings（配件）、sideways（横着）、fill an order（按订单配货）、dispatch（发货）。
exp.meaning: 侧面编号让工作人员不用翻箱便能分清配件。最后一句的 due to packing errors 修饰 returns，交代退货的原因。
exp.rest: 原文没有说客户缺收据、库存不够，或要用编号记录发货前的检查。新编号的位置针对的是货架上看不见原编号的问题。

questions.target: train a model 与 track a result
questions.skill: 从动词宾语区分训练与跟踪结果
questions.q:
The archive trained an AI model to recognise place names in handwritten letters. It then tracked the proportion of names the model missed in letters it had never seen.

What did the archive do with the unfamiliar letters?
o: It provided the letters as new examples for the model to train on.
It recorded how often the model failed to recognise a place name.
It traced the addresses to find out who had written the letters.
It corrected the spelling of the names before testing the model.

exp.trans: 档案馆训练了一个 AI 模型来识别手写信里的地名，随后用模型没见过的信统计它遗漏地名的比例。
exp.structure: 第一句是 trained a model，第二句的 then 把 tracked the proportion 排在训练之后。it had never seen 修饰 letters，内层 it 指模型。
exp.other: recognise（识别）、handwritten（手写的）、proportion（比例）、miss（漏掉）。
exp.meaning: train 在这里作动词，指训练模型。track 指记录或追踪一个量，这里记录模型面对新信件时漏认地名的情况。
exp.rest: 未见过的信在此用来观察模型表现。原句没有把它们用作训练例子，也没有追查作者或先改拼写。

questions.passage:
A school district has responded to falling reading scores by buying extra tutoring hours. The help is welcome, particularly for pupils who have missed lessons. Yet the district's own review found that frequent timetable changes were repeatedly interrupting the normal reading classes. Paying for more teaching after school leaves that problem untouched.

The tutoring contract may prevent some pupils from falling further behind. It should not become a reason to postpone a more awkward discussion about how the school day is organised. A system that regularly disrupts its own lessons cannot put matters right simply by purchasing additional ones. The extra help is useful; a dependable timetable is still essential.
questions.q: Which of the following would be the best title for the text?
o: Why Reading Scores Call for Rapid Action
Extra Lessons Cannot Repair a Broken Timetable
After-School Tutors Deserve Greater Recognition
How Families Can Help Children Read at Home
questions.target: 标题须包含作者对现有措施不充分的评价
questions.skill: 标题须包含作者对现有措施不充分的评价
questions.answer_support: A system that regularly disrupts its own lessons cannot put matters right simply by purchasing additional ones.

exp.trans: 额外辅导有用，但正常阅读课不断被打断，作者主张处理课程安排本身的问题。
exp.structure: 先认可补救，再指出根因仍在，末段要求把改善基本安排纳入对策。
exp.other: dependable：可靠的；put matters right：纠正问题。
exp.meaning: 正确标题抓住额外辅导无法代替稳定课程安排的论点。快速行动与阅读下降相关，但不是作者最强调的区别。
exp.rest: 紧急行动只概括背景需求；肯定辅导教师、家庭阅读均非文章论证中心。

questions.passage:
A booking website crashes whenever too many customers arrive at once. Staff have learned to restart the server, and the service usually returns within minutes. Customers are understandably relieved when it comes back, but the same failure reappears the next busy evening.

An engineer calls the restart a Band-Aid. It restores access without changing the weakness that causes the site to fail under heavy demand. The company still needs to examine how requests are handled and where capacity is lost. A response that ends today's interruption can be useful while remaining inadequate as an answer to the recurring problem.
questions.q: The engineer uses "Band-Aid" to describe a
o: useful but temporary response to the failure.
complete redesign of the booking website.
financial guarantee offered to disappointed customers.
method of preventing every increase in demand.
questions.target: Band-Aid比喻临时补救，不把bank aid回忆补造成既定误译
questions.skill: Band-Aid比喻临时补救，不把bank aid回忆补造成既定误译
questions.answer_support: It restores access without changing the weakness that causes the site to fail

exp.trans: 重启能暂时恢复网站，但高峰时故障反复出现，工程师称它为临时补救。
exp.structure: 第一段给出反复现象，第二段区分恢复当下使用和解决反复成因。
exp.other: Band-Aid：创可贴，引申为临时补救；recurring：反复出现的。
exp.meaning: 正确项保留暂时有用与未解决成因两点。这不是银行援助的表达，也不是说该应急行动毫无作用。
exp.rest: 全面重设计尚未发生；客户财务担保无依据；避免一切需求增长不是重启的作用。

questions.target: 题干对象 / 评价对象匹配
questions.skill: 关键词相似前先核对主语
questions.q: A review says: “The report contains pages of anecdotes and too little analysis of why small firms avoid the subsidy.” It later adds: “The subsidy’s most serious weakness is that participation falls once temporary bonuses end.” If asked what the report fails to do, which answer is best?
o: explain adequately why small firms avoid the subsidy
produce participation that lasts after bonuses end
remove all anecdotes from the discussion
prove that temporary bonuses never increase participation

exp.trans: 评论先说报告轶事过多，却没有充分分析小企业为何避开补贴；后面又说补贴本身最严重的问题是奖金结束后参与度下降。若题干问“报告没做到什么”，答案应回到报告本身。
exp.structure: 第一句The report是被评价对象；第二句The subsidy’s most serious weakness把评价对象切换成补贴政策。题干再次锁定the report。
exp.other: anecdote 轶事；subsidy 补贴；participation 参与度；temporary bonus 临时奖励。
exp.meaning: 看到most serious weakness之类强信号不能直接选，先检查这个weakness属于谁。正确选项可以只改写并列句中的一侧，不必覆盖整句所有批评。
exp.rest: “produce participation that lasts...”描述的是subsidy的持久效果，不是report的写作缺陷；“remove all anecdotes”把too many夸大成必须全部删除；“prove...never”加入绝对化的never和原文没有的证明要求。

questions.target: complement 和 compliment 的语境辨析
questions.skill: 从两人的实际贡献判断彼此关系
questions.passage: A publisher asked two editors to prepare an edition of a seventeenth-century play. One could read the author's cramped handwriting, but many of the stage directions referred to equipment whose use was no longer familiar. The other had worked with replicas in a theatre museum and recognised those references. On some pages the museum editor could not begin until the text had been transcribed. The publisher praised the edition for making the author's staging clear, something neither editor could have achieved alone.
questions.q: How did the two editors contribute to the new edition?
o: They complimented one another on their work.
They repeated each other's work on the play.
They counterbalanced each other's influence on the text.
Their editorial skills complemented each other.
questions.answer_support: something neither editor could have achieved alone

exp.trans: 一家出版社请两位编辑整理一部十七世纪戏剧。一位能辨认作者密而潦草的手写体。另一位曾在戏剧博物馆接触道具复制品，能理解舞台说明里提到的旧设备。有些页得先誊写才能解释，最终的舞台说明清晰度是两人各自无法独立做到的。
exp.structure: One 和 The other 分别交代两人的强项。until 所在句表明辨读手稿为解释旧设备提供了前提，末句说清楚这一成果需要两人的贡献。
exp.other: cramped handwriting（密而潦草的字迹）、stage directions（舞台说明）、replica（复制品）、transcribe（誊写）。
exp.meaning: 二人的专长分别补上了对方缺的一环，符合 complement each other's expertise。compliment 表示称赞，例如 compliment an editor on a new edition。
exp.rest: 称赞者是出版社，材料未说两名编辑互相称赞。一个辨字，一个解读设备，两人的任务有区别。他们也没有以相反的作用相互制衡。

amount-to-meaning.passage:
A transport authority has invited residents to comment on a station plan after the main contracts have been signed. Officials promise to listen, but they cannot change the entrance, the route of the access road or the hours of construction. Only the colour of a boundary fence remains open for discussion.

Under those conditions, the consultation amounts to a formality. An opportunity to speak is of limited value when the decisions that matter have already been made. Public participation should occur while alternatives remain possible, not merely provide a final stage in a process whose outcome is no longer in doubt.
amount-to-meaning.q: The phrase "amounts to" in Paragraph 2 is closest in meaning to
o: is effectively.
is caused by.
depends upon.
argues against.
amount-to-meaning.target: amount to在评价语境表示实际上相当于
amount-to-meaning.skill: amount to在评价语境表示实际上相当于
amount-to-meaning.answer_support: the consultation amounts to a formality

exp.trans: 主要决定已定，居民仅能讨论围栏颜色，因此所谓咨询实际只剩形式。
exp.structure: 前段提供受限范围，后段以amounts to对咨询的实质作评价。
exp.other: formality：形式性程序；consultation：征求意见。
exp.meaning: is effectively表达实际上等于、实质上是；本句不是数字总计，也不表示因果或反对。
exp.rest: is caused by改成因果；depends upon改成依赖条件；argues against改成持反对观点。

amount-to-meaning.passage:
A local newspaper wants subscribers to understand what their payments support. Its annual accounts separate printing, delivery and reporting costs. Payments to freelance reporters amount to a substantial share of the total, although each individual assignment may appear inexpensive when considered on its own.

The distinction between a single payment and the combined cost matters to the newspaper's plans. Reducing one small fee would do little if the same work then had to be purchased elsewhere. The accounts are intended to show where spending accumulates across a year, rather than suggest that the most visible invoice must be the most important one.
amount-to-meaning.q: The phrase "amount to" in Paragraph 1 is closest in meaning to
o: make room for.
fall short of.
depend upon.
add up to.
amount-to-meaning.target: amount to也可表示总计达到，不固定只记一种义
amount-to-meaning.skill: amount to也可表示总计达到，不固定只记一种义
amount-to-meaning.answer_support: Payments to freelance reporters amount to a substantial share of the total

exp.trans: 报社说明零散稿费合计占全年开支的重要部分，单项小不代表合计不重要。
exp.structure: 第一段呈现单项与总量差别，第二段解释核算全年支出的意义。
exp.other: freelance：自由职业的；invoice：账单；accumulate：累积。
exp.meaning: add up to对应总计达到。本题与“相当于形式”语境不同，要按宾语和上下文判断义项。
exp.rest: 留出空间、低于和依赖都没有表达累计占比的关系。

amount-to-meaning.target: amount to 表示累计达到的量
amount-to-meaning.skill: 从多个小量识别累计结果
amount-to-meaning.passage: The budget for a play counts the hours spent building the set and rehearsing on stage. It gives little attention to the short meetings in which the director and technical crew agree on changes. Individually, those meetings rarely last more than twenty minutes. Over the life of a production, however, they amount to almost a full working day. A revised budget now includes this time, so that the theatre has a more accurate estimate of how much work a new play requires.
amount-to-meaning.q: What does the passage say about the duration of the meetings?
o: Their time adds up to nearly a full working day.
Each is scheduled to last at least twenty minutes.
They are held together on one separate working day.
Their length depends on the time spent building sets.
amount-to-meaning.answer_support: Over the life of a production, however, they amount to almost a full working day.

exp.trans: 剧院原预算算了搭景和排练的时长，往往忽略商量改动的短会。单场通常不到二十分钟，但一部剧的会议时间加起来接近一整天，因此新版预算也算入这段工时。
exp.structure: Individually 说一场会，over the life of a production 说整个制作周期。however 转到累加后的结果。
exp.other: set（舞台布景）、rehearse（排练）、technical crew（技术人员）、estimate（估算）。
exp.meaning: amount to 后接一段工时，表示多次开会累计接近一天。
exp.rest: 二十分钟是单场会议较少超过的时长。会议分散在制作期间，也没有被说成由搭景时间决定。

example-claim-scope.target: 具体反对行动支持哪条主旨
example-claim-scope.skill: 例子→论点 / 不能多推态度变化
example-claim-scope.q: A city report says proposals to digitize building permits have repeatedly stalled because established interests resist change. It cites a builders' association that organized petitions and delayed the new system for six months. What does the example mainly illustrate?
o: Organized groups can impede administrative reforms.
The association persuaded every resident to change political allegiance.
Most builders oppose the current political system in all circumstances.
Digital permits always cost more than paper applications.

exp.trans: 城市报告说，建筑许可数字化改革屡次被既有利益团体阻挠，并举建筑协会组织请愿、使新系统推迟六个月的例子。例子说明利益团体可能阻碍行政改革。
exp.structure: 主句proposals ... have stalled because...提出上层论点；It cites an association ...是作为证据的例子；organized petitions / delayed是例子中的行为与结果。
exp.other: digitize 数字化；permit 许可证；established interests 既有利益集团；administrative reform 行政改革。
exp.meaning: 例证题先找例子附近作者要证明的论点：改革遭遇阻力。组织请愿不等于改变公众政治立场；反对一项改革也不等于反对整个政治制度。
exp.rest: 政治归属改变需要前后态度证据；所有情况下反对现行政治制度扩大对象与频率；数字许可成本并未涉及。

example-claim-scope.target: 例子与论点的对应范围
example-claim-scope.skill: 不能靠团体行动推固定结论
example-claim-scope.q: An article argues that locally organized groups can sometimes help an unpopular policy get started. It describes a farmers' cooperative that trained volunteers and persuaded members to test a water-saving system, helping the trial begin on schedule. What is the role of this example?
o: It measures a shift in members' views on conservation.
It shows why government funds were needed for the trial.
It explains how the new system reduced water consumption.
It illustrates how local groups can help launch a policy.

exp.trans: 文章认为地方组织有时能帮助不受欢迎的政策启动，随后举农民合作社培训志愿者、推动成员试用节水系统，使试验按时开展的例子。这个例子是在支持‘团体也能帮助政策落实’。
exp.structure: An article argues + that从句是主张；It describes...引出实例；helping the trial begin是实例中的实际结果。
exp.other: cooperative 合作社；facilitate 促进；implementation 落实；trial 试行。
exp.meaning: 例子支持的结论可以是促进改革，也可以是阻碍改革，取决于前后文。不要机械地把‘团体动员’与‘妨碍改革’绑定。
exp.rest: 没有成员前后态度的测量，不能证明观点转变；材料没有交代政府资金；也没有比较节水系统的技术效果。合作社组织志愿者和动员试用，支持的是政策启动机制。

example-claim-scope.skill: 识别反例对充分条件的限制而非扩大成全面否定
example-claim-scope.q: A consultant argues that longer opening hours are enough to widen access to museums. A writer responds with a neighbourhood museum that stayed open until 10 p.m., yet attracted few additional night-shift workers. Interviews revealed that the last bus serving their workplaces left at 8 p.m. Why does the writer include this case?
o: To show that transport constraints can limit what extended hours achieve.
To identify reduced bus services as a consequence of the later museum hours.
To compare tourists' reasons for visiting with those of local residents.
To present later opening as a substitute for improving transport links.

exp.trans: 顾问认为，只要延长开放时间，就足以让更多人有机会参观博物馆。作者回应说，一家社区博物馆开放到晚上十点，却几乎没有多吸引夜班工人。访谈发现，途经他们工作地点的末班公交在晚上八点就开走了。作者为何举这个例子？为了说明交通限制会影响延长开放时间的实际效果。
exp.structure: A consultant + argues + that从句提出待检验的充分条件；A writer + responds with + a museum引出反例。that stayed open...为修饰museum的定语从句；yet转向预期未实现的结果；Interviews + revealed + that从句提供限制条件。
exp.other: widen access 扩大参与机会；neighbourhood 社区；night-shift worker 夜班工人；extended hours 延长的开放时间；transport link 交通连接。
exp.meaning: 例子针对的是延长开放时间是否单独就足够。公交仍是障碍，说明措施的效果受另一条件限制；没有证明延时开放普遍无效，也没有比较不同群体的喜好。
exp.rest: 末班车时间是已有约束，文中没有说公交服务因博物馆延时而削减；游客与本地居民的参观动机没有被比较；例子指出仅延时仍不足，不能反说延时可以替代交通改善。

example-claim-scope.skill: 把实例放回可见记录与实际行为的区分
example-claim-scope.q: An essay distinguishes a visible change in records from a change in underlying behaviour. It describes a factory where reported near-misses increased after a safety bonus was introduced. An anonymous survey found no change in how often hazards occurred; workers said they had previously kept quiet about them. What does the case illustrate?
o: The bonus increased hazards along with reports of near-misses.
Official incident totals are more reliable than the survey.
Anonymity motivated workers more than the safety bonus did.
Reporting changes can raise counts without raising hazards.

exp.trans: 文章区分记录上的可见变化与实际行为的变化。文中举例，一家工厂引入安全奖励后，上报的险情增多。匿名调查发现，危险出现的频率并没有变化；工人说自己以前对这些情况保持沉默。这个例子说明，记录数量上升可能源自上报方式改变，而不意味着危险同步增加。
exp.structure: An essay + distinguishes + A from B提出上层区分；It + describes + a factory引出例子，where从句补充上报数量变化。was introduced是被动谓语。An anonymous survey + found + no change；how often hazards occurred补充频率。had previously kept quiet指出早期漏报背景。
exp.other: near-miss 险些发生的事故、险情；underlying 实际的、深层的；anonymous 匿名的；hazard 危险因素；incident total 事件总数。
exp.meaning: 实例在支持记录变化不等于实际事件变化这一论点。新增上报与此前沉默形成对照，不能把记录增多直接推成工作更危险；也不应把例证题改答成未讨论的奖励与匿名措施孰强。
exp.rest: 调查显示危险发生频率未变，不能断言奖励增加危险；材料没有给两种数据排可靠性名次；匿名是调查方式，不能据此比较匿名与奖金的激励强度。

example-claim-scope.skill: 区分记录数量变化与真实风险变化
example-claim-scope.q: After a factory introduced anonymous reporting, recorded safety events rose. Independent inspections found no increase in hazards. Which conclusion is best supported?
o: The factory became more dangerous after anonymous reporting was introduced.
The rise in reports proves workers deliberately exaggerated safety incidents.
The higher event count may reflect reporting changes rather than more hazards.
Independent inspections confirmed that hazards increased throughout the factory.

exp.trans: 工厂引入匿名报告后，记录到的安全事件增加了，但独立检查没有发现危险因素增加。最有根据的结论是：记录数量的上升可能来自报告方式的变化，而非真实危险增加。
exp.structure: After引导时间背景；recorded safety events rose描述记录数；Independent inspections found no increase in hazards提供独立证据，限制了对真实风险的推断。
exp.other: anonymous reporting 匿名报告；recorded event 记录到的事件；independent inspection 独立检查；hazard 危险因素。
exp.meaning: 报告数量是观测到的数据，可能受报告机制影响；不能直接把记录数增加等同于真实危险增加。
exp.rest: 直接断言工厂更危险，与独立检查结果不符；把报告增加归因于故意夸大，原文没有动机证据；把检查结果说反了。

scene-evidence-chain.target: 用观察与验证解释下一步行动
scene-evidence-chain.skill: 把现象、原因和后续行动连在一起
scene-evidence-chain.passage: An archive's project to transcribe oral histories ran into an unexpected problem. Recordings made in its new interview room contained a low hum, but recordings of the same speakers elsewhere were clear. The sound was strongest in interviews conducted near the air vent. A technician briefly turned off the fan, and the hum disappeared. Rather than asking speakers to repeat their accounts more loudly, the team moved the interview table and microphone to the quiet end of the room. It could then keep the fan running during interviews.
scene-evidence-chain.q: Why did the team move the interview table?
o: To let the speakers repeat passages without stopping the fan.
To pick up the speech of visitors who sat farther from the table.
To improve sound quality in all the archive's interview rooms.
To record farther from the source of the background noise.
scene-evidence-chain.answer_support: The sound was strongest in interviews conducted near the air vent. A technician briefly turned off the fan, and the hum disappeared.

exp.trans: 档案馆新访谈室的录音里有低沉的嗡嗡声，相同受访者在别处的录音却很清楚。通风口附近录到的噪音最强，停风扇时它消失。团队把访谈桌和麦克风移到较安静的一端，访谈期间仍可开风扇。
exp.structure: 先比较同一批人不同地点的录音，再用停风扇验证嗡嗡声的来源，最后移动录音位置。rather than 引出团队没有采用的应对办法。
exp.other: transcribe（转写）、oral history（口述史）、hum（低沉的嗡嗡声）、air vent（通风口）。
exp.meaning: 录音难辨与通风噪音的位置有关。移动访谈桌让麦克风远离噪音最强的位置。
exp.rest: 请受访者重复是文中未采用的办法。文中没提到远座位上的访客，措施也只针对这一间访谈室。

train-track-polysemy.target: train track 的铁轨义与 track 的追踪义
train-track-polysemy.skill: 从动作和对象识别同一词的不同用法
train-track-polysemy.q:
In the week before the station reopened, crews replaced several sections of train track. A local reporter tracked the work to find out which services could resume on Monday.

Which account best describes what happened?
o: Crews repaired the trains, and the reporter checked their schedules.
Crews renewed the rails, and the reporter followed their progress.
Crews changed the route, and the reporter made the first journey.
Crews reopened the station, and the reporter counted its passengers.

exp.trans: 车站重新开放前的一周，施工人员更换了几段铁轨。当地记者跟踪施工进度，想弄清哪些班次能在周一恢复。
exp.structure: replaced 的宾语是 sections of train track，说明更换的是哪一样实体。tracked 的宾语是 the work，说明记者持续关注的是施工进度。
exp.other: crew（作业人员）、section（一段）、service（班次或服务）、resume（恢复）。
exp.meaning: train track 中 train 修饰名词 track，合起来表示铁轨。tracked the work 中 track 是动词，表示跟踪工程进度。
exp.rest: 拆换铁轨和维修列车是两项工作。文中也没有改线路、记者搭第一班车或统计乘客这些动作。

title-coverage.passage:
Applicants for a training grant used to submit the same address details to three offices. A mismatch between the forms could delay an otherwise complete application for weeks. After staff traced the problem, the offices agreed to use one shared form. The change was introduced within days, and most applications could then move through the system without repeated checks of identical information.

There is a temptation to judge a reform's seriousness by how long it takes. This case points the other way. The change was quick because the obstacle was specific and the people involved had authority to remove it. Speed did not make the improvement superficial; it spared applicants another season of unnecessary delay.
title-coverage.q: Which of the following would be the best title for the text?
o: A Grant Scheme in Need of More Patient Applicants
The Risks of Sharing Information Between Offices
A Swift Reform with Lasting Practical Benefits
Why Major Reforms Must Begin with Longer Forms
title-coverage.target: 不把快速解决一律误判成临时补救
title-coverage.skill: 不把快速解决一律误判成临时补救
title-coverage.answer_support: Speed did not make the improvement superficial

exp.trans: 重复填表造成等待，统一表格迅速移除了具体障碍。作者强调迅速并不等于表面应付。
exp.structure: 第一段呈现原因、行动与结果，第二段明确评价速度与改革价值的关系。
exp.other: superficial：表面的；trace：查明；obstacle：障碍。
exp.meaning: 本文恰好支持快速且有效的改革。标题判断必须跟随材料，不能学成见到quick就排除。
exp.rest: 要求申请人更耐心、警惕信息共享或延长表格，均不符合作者对这次改革的肯定。

title-coverage.passage:
Public libraries have spent heavily on faster internet connections and new computers. For residents without reliable access at home, those investments matter. Yet librarians report that some visitors still leave without completing the task that brought them in. A working computer is little help to someone unsure how to fill in an online form or judge whether a message is genuine.

Several libraries are now assigning staff to offer short, practical sessions alongside the equipment. The service costs money and takes time away from other duties. But if public access is to mean more than a row of available screens, helping people use the connection deserves a place in the budget too.
title-coverage.q: Which of the following would be the best title for the text?
o: Bringing Every Library Service Online
A Better Connection Is Only a Beginning
Making Public Computers Pay Their Way
Why Libraries Are Losing Their Readers
title-coverage.target: 标题概括问题与解决方向，不只复现一个话题词
title-coverage.skill: 标题概括问题与解决方向，不只复现一个话题词
title-coverage.answer_support: helping people use the connection deserves a place in the budget too

exp.trans: 图书馆配置网络和电脑后，部分读者仍缺少使用技能；作者主张把人员指导也纳入公共数字服务。
exp.structure: 从硬件投入的成效和不足，推进到实用指导的需求与经费，形成“连接只是起点”的论点。
exp.other: genuine：真实的；assign：安排；alongside：与……同时。
exp.meaning: 正确标题同时覆盖硬件有用和仅有硬件不够这两层观点，包含文章后半部分提出的支持措施。
exp.rest: 把所有服务搬到线上不是文章主张；让电脑挣钱误读了公共预算讨论；文章也没有说图书馆正在失去读者。

title-coverage.passage:
An empty shop is more than a gap in a shopping street. When several remain vacant, fewer people pass through, and the surviving businesses lose customers. Simply advertising the empty units has done little where the rent and the cost of fitting out a whole shop are beyond a new trader's reach.

A local partnership is now dividing several units into small shared spaces. Traders pay for a stall and basic services instead of taking on an entire building. The arrangement will not rescue every shopping street, but it tackles one reason premises stay unused. Reviving a high street may depend less on finding a single large tenant than on making room for several small ones.
title-coverage.q: Which of the following would be the best title for the text?
o: Why Small Shops Need Larger Buildings
The Cost of Advertising Vacant Properties
Giving Empty Shops a Shared Future
How Large Retailers Choose Their Tenants
title-coverage.target: 从整篇主线概括复兴途径，而非选择背景细节作标题
title-coverage.skill: 从整篇主线概括复兴途径，而非选择背景细节作标题
title-coverage.answer_support: Reviving a high street may depend less on finding a single large tenant than on making room for several small ones.

exp.trans: 空铺加剧街区衰落，整间租用费用又阻挡小商户进入；共享铺位降低门槛，为街区复兴提供一种途径。
exp.structure: 先说明空置问题和原有办法的不足，再解释共享方案及其适用限度。
exp.other: premises：经营场所；fit out：装修配备；tenant：租户。
exp.meaning: 正确标题覆盖空铺问题和共享利用的解决方向。它没有承诺所有街区都能因此获救。
exp.rest: 更大的建筑与小商户实际面临的负担相反；广告费用只是背景且非主线；文章不讨论大型零售商挑选租户。

band-aid-remedy.passage:
A community arts programme is about to cancel its next season when a sponsor offers a single donation. The gift pays the venue bill and allows the advertised workshops to go ahead. The organisers are grateful, but the programme has lost several regular supporters and has no dependable income for the following year.

One trustee calls the donation a Band-Aid rather than a funding strategy. The point is not to dismiss the sponsor's generosity. It is to recognise that a payment which prevents an immediate cancellation does not establish a reliable way to finance future work. The programme needs both relief now and a plan for what follows.
band-aid-remedy.q: The trustee's description of the donation as a "Band-Aid" stresses its
o: dependence on the venue's willingness to cancel events.
ability to replace the programme's regular supporters.
failure to help with any of the current expenses.
limited role in addressing a continuing funding problem.
band-aid-remedy.target: 区分一次应急支持和可持续解决方案
band-aid-remedy.skill: 区分一次应急支持和可持续解决方案
band-aid-remedy.answer_support: a payment which prevents an immediate cancellation does not establish a reliable way to finance future work

exp.trans: 一次捐款救下本季活动，但并未建立往后的稳定收入来源；作者承认好处并限定其作用。
exp.structure: 先交代危机和缓解，再区分即时救助与持续资助。
exp.other: trustee：受托管理者；dependable：可靠的；relief：缓解、救济。
exp.meaning: 正确项是对持续问题的作用有限，不是把捐赠说成无效或已有完整财务方案。
exp.rest: 场地方取消意愿不是比喻重点；常规支持者流失未被解决；当期场地费确实已获帮助。

scope-role-match.target: 并列信息 / 主语对象
scope-role-match.skill: 正确选项可对应并列句一侧
scope-role-match.q: A critic writes: “The study gives a detailed history of the device but offers little investigation of the failures reported in cold weather.” Two sentences later: “The device’s clearest flaw is that its battery loses capacity after repeated freezing.” What does the study fail to do?
o: provide any historical background
investigate the cold-weather failures sufficiently
prevent the battery from losing capacity
make the device work indefinitely in freezing conditions

exp.trans: 评论者说研究对设备历史讲得很详细，但对寒冷天气中的故障调查不足。后面说设备本身最明显的缺陷是反复结冰后电池容量下降。题目问study，因此答案是调查不足。
exp.structure: but连接两个对study的评价：history详细，failure investigation不足；后句The device’s clearest flaw把主语切到device。
exp.other: capacity 容量；freezing 冰冻环境；investigation 调查；critic 评论者。
exp.meaning: 并列句里一半信息就可以被题目抽出来做同义替换。不要因为答案没同时复述history和failure两侧就排除。
exp.rest: “provide any historical background”与detailed history相反；要求study去prevent battery loss或让device indefinitely work in freezing conditions，都是把研究报告与设备本身的职责混在一起。
